name: ovos-common-query-pipeline-plugin
description: The OVOS Common Query Framework answers questions. It gathers answers from several skills and picks the best one.
author: OpenVoiceOS

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
This plugin ships with [ovos-core](https://github.com/OpenVoiceOS/ovos-core) by default. You do not need to install it explicitly.

pip install ovos-common-query-pipeline-plugin
